prompt: Make a square 1080x1080 social media card announcing a free community workshop, Intro to Bread Baking, on Saturday, March 14 at 10:00 am at the Eastmoor Library, community room B. It is free, people should bring an apron, and they can sign up at eastmoor.example/bread. Keep it friendly.
prompt_suffix: Return the result as a single self-contained HTML file: all CSS inline, no external requests, system fonts only. Reply with one ```html fenced block and nothing else.
rubric: The workshop title is clearly the dominant element and is much larger than every other piece of text.
The date, time and place are easy to find, grouped together, and use no more than about three levels of emphasis overall.
Lines are set comfortably: sensible line length and line-height, no awkward one-word last lines, and no clipped or cramped text.
The card uses a small, consistent set of type styles (one or two families, few sizes and weights) with consistent alignment.
All text, including the smallest line, has strong contrast and is readable at phone size.
featuring_rule: Declared before any run: rank the 3 without-skill runs and the 3 with-skill runs separately by the blind judge's rubric mean (two passes with the sides swapped, scores averaged), and feature the median run of each arm. The best run is never chosen. The contact sheet shows all six runs.

pairs.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Answer A overflows the canvas: the sign-up bar is cut off at the bottom edge, so the URL and the apron note never appear, and its info card uses several label, bold and small-text levels. Answer B fits all the required information inside the frame, groups the details cleanly in one card with a clear sign-up bar, and keeps a strong title hierarchy. B's split alignment of 'Sign up:' and the URL is slightly awkward, and its bold-plus-regular mixes add a little emphasis noise, but the card is complete and readable. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A fits all the required information on the card, including the apron reminder and the sign-up URL, and its type hierarchy is clean with a dominant title and a well-grouped details box. B's sign-up element is cut off at the bottom edge, so the URL and the apron note are missing entirely. B's subtitle also sits tight against the details box, and it uses more type styles (italic serif, small-caps labels, several weights and sizes).

pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both cards are cut off at the bottom, so neither shows the sign-up URL. A loses more: its free/apron line and button are clipped, and the 'g' in 'Baking' runs into the details box. B keeps the title dominant and fits the date, place and 'bring an apron' into a clear grouped box. B's weaknesses are an awkward 'Community / Room B' line break and an extra heavy display face mixed with the serif and sans. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both cards are cut off at the bottom and lose the sign-up URL. B's damage is easier to see: the 'Free to join. Just…' line stops mid-sentence, the button is clipped, and the descender of 'Baking' runs into the info box. A has a cleaner hierarchy and a well-grouped info box, but it mixes more type styles and awkwardly wraps 'Community / Room B'. B's type system is tidier and more consistent, but its layout problems weigh more.

pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both titles clearly dominate. B groups the details best, with a WHEN/WHERE/BRING box and only three levels of emphasis, but 'Room B' wraps and leaves a lone 'B' on its own line. A has more layout problems: 'FOR EVERYONE' runs past the edge of the Free badge, the tagline is squeezed against the bullet list, and 'free' appears three times, so B wins narrowly. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both cards make the title dominant and look warm and friendly. A has an awkward orphaned 'B' wrapping onto its own line in the location, uses more type styles inside the info box, and its tagline is cramped against the box. B groups the details more simply and evenly, but the 'FOR EVERYONE' text on its stamp runs past the circle's edge, and its tagline sits tight above the bullets. On balance B is slightly cleaner.
